_comment: Registry of the projects shown on the start screen. 'investigations' must match catalogue values. Texts describe what the source documents state; no results are claimed here.

projects.title: ACME CFI-G: cool flames in gases
projects.mission: ACME, Combustion Integrated Rack-free chamber on the ISS
projects.summary: Spherical gas flames of ethane, propane and butane burned in microgravity at different oxygen levels and pressures. Some runs show cool flames, a faint low-temperature burning that can persist after the hot flame goes out.
projects.measures: Radiometers, photomultipliers (flame light), thermocouples, gas flows and chamber pressure at 125 Hz.

projects.title: CFI / FLEX: burning fuel droplets
projects.mission: Flame Extinguishment Experiment on the ISS Combustion Integrated Rack
projects.summary: Single dodecane droplets burned in microgravity. The droplet shrinks as D² falls roughly linearly in time; some runs also show a cool flame around the droplet.
projects.measures: Droplet diameter, cool-flame diameter and radiometer power over time.

projects.title: Flame Design: shaping flames
projects.summary: Ethylene and other fuel flames on a spherical burner, normal and inverse, at about one atmosphere. Tabulated fuel fraction, adiabatic flame temperature and mixture fraction accompany each run.
projects.measures: The same 125 Hz ACME channels as CFI-G, plus tabulated flame conditions.

projects.title: Saffire-III: a fire aboard a spacecraft
projects.mission: Spacecraft Fire Safety Demonstration, Cygnus cargo vehicle
projects.summary: A fire lit on purpose in a 0.4 m x 0.94 m SIBAL fabric sample inside a Cygnus vehicle after it left the ISS. The sensors show temperature, radiant heat, oxygen and CO2 through the burn, and the vehicle's own smoke detector shows what a spacecraft would notice.
projects.measures: Thermocouples, radiometers, gas composition, air flow and pressure at 30 Hz, plus 1 Hz telemetry with the Cygnus smoke detector.

projects.title: E-FIELD Flames: steering flames with electricity
projects.mission: ACME on the ISS (Prof. D. Dunn-Rankin, UC Irvine)
projects.summary: Methane and ethylene diffusion flames in microgravity with up to ±10 kV applied between a mesh and the burner. The flame's ion current and shape respond to the field strength and polarity.
projects.measures: Mesh voltage, ion current, flame light (PMTs), thermocouples, gas flows and pressure at 125 Hz.

projects.title: SAME-R: smoke from spacecraft materials
projects.summary: Samples of spacecraft materials such as Kapton, Teflon, silicone, lampwick and Pyrell are heated until they smoke, and smoke detectors and particle counters record the result in microgravity.
projects.measures: ISS and shuttle smoke detectors, ionization detectors, particle counts, plume temperature and flow at about 1 Hz.
